$comment: Single source of truth for the bundled translation models. scripts/fetch-translation-models.mjs downloads them to public/mt/<pair id>/, and src/translation/bergamotTranslator.ts loads them from there. Models are Mozilla's Firefox Translations models, served from the same Remote Settings CDN Firefox itself uses; every record carries a sha256 the fetch verifies. Versions are pinned so a rebuild produces the same image.

pairs.label: German → English
pairs.note: base architecture, BLEU 41.6 on FLORES. About 36 MB.
